Text: HCTZ reduces the fluid volume in your body, which can lead to sudden kidney injury. The risk is higher if you have chronic kidney disease, heart failure, or are already low on fluid. If you have liver disease, small changes in fluid and salt balance can trigger a serious complication called hepatic coma. Your doctor will monitor your kidney function and watch for changes in alertness.
Sudden vision changes need urgent care:
Rarely, hydrochlorothiazide causes sudden short-sightedness (acute myopia) and a sharp rise in pressure inside the eye (acute angle-closure glaucoma), usually within hours to weeks of starting the medicine. Stop taking it and get medical help immediately if your vision drops suddenly or your eye hurts. Left untreated, this can cause permanent loss of vision. A history of allergy to sulfa medicines or penicillin may increase the risk.
Blood sugar, cholesterol, uric acid and calcium:
Triplet: ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has effect on", "calcium"]

The relation 'has effect on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug influences or alters the level or condition of the biomarker or physiological parameter specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has interaction effect': The co-administration of the subject drug with the specified entity results in a measurable change in pharmacological parameters such as blood levels, duration, or physiological effects.
D. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
